messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1792034567 — Latency SLO breach detected for /v1/generate (p95/p99). Triggered at 2026-03-14T03:02:47Z. Paging: @oncall-ana.

oncall-ana: I'm on it. seeing p95 ~ 420ms -> 1.8s and p99 ~ 4.2s on hosted region-us-west-2. Streaming tail stalls also reported.

mike_sre: grabbing traces. Initial look: big tail at 'feature-flag-eval' RPC to control-plane (config service) — spikes line up with config fetch timeouts.

kevin_prodeng: any deploys or config rollouts in last 10m?

sara_poe: no prod deploys. Last config release 40m ago. We did flip a small feature-flag yesterday but nothing today.

mike_sre: logs show error 504 from config-service at ~03:01:xx and a flood of retries from frontend instances. KV cache miss rate jumped ~5x.

oncall-ana: customer-facing impact? josh_sales, any customer reports?

josh_sales: A few enterprise customers reported timeouts and streaming stalls; one said sessions repeatedly stalled for ~10s. Escalated to AE for Customer A.

mike_sre: mitigation plan proposal: 1) disable remote feature-flag eval streaming path (fall back to local default) 2) enable short-circuit caching for config fetches (serve stale for 10s) 3) increase control-plane read capacity (DB replica) — in that order.

oncall-ana: agree. Prioritize fast, reversible actions. I'll toggle the feature flag fallback first.

kevin_prodeng: if we swap to local defaults, risk of behavior change; but acceptable for availability. Who can flip?

sara_poe: I can issue the flag fallback. Doing so now.

[sara_poe toggles feature flag to local-default]

sara_poe: done — feature flag fallback enabled across region-us-west-2. Confirming rollout to all prod frontends.

mike_sre: seeing immediate drop in RPC count to control-plane, error-rate for config-service falling. p95 dropping to ~250-300ms.

deploy-bot: INFO: started on-demand cache short-circuit job on 12 frontends — serving stale configs for 10s.

oncall-ana: enabling short-circuit cache now.

mike_sre: p99 still elevated ~1.2s but trending down. Streaming stalls reduced but a small fraction still show KV cache misses.

kevin_prodeng: can infra add a read replica to the config DB? If DB CPU is the bottleneck that's next.

mike_sre: submitted DB replica request to infra. ETA ~8m for read replica promotion.

oncall-ana: note to timeline: initial detection 03:02:47Z -> FF fallback ~03:04:10Z -> cache short-circuit ~03:05:00Z. Major customer impact window ~03:02:47Z–03:05:50Z.

josh_sales: telling AEs to notify affected customers that we've mitigated and are monitoring.

mike_sre: DB replica added, read throughput spike reduced. p99 back to ~320ms. Streams stable.

oncall-ana: I'll stay on watch for another 30m and then hand off to day-shift. Can someone prepare a short post-incident summary?

sara_poe: I'll draft the timeline and mitigation actions.

kevin_prodeng: root cause hypothesis: intermittent control-plane DB contention causing config-service timeouts; client-side behavior amplified the impact due to synchronous feature-flag evals without local fallback.

mike_sre: agree. Follow-ups: (a) make local default fallback automatic on config-timeout (b) increase circuit-breaker + backoff to avoid thundering herd (c) add wide-path KV pre-warming for spike windows (d) infra: investigate DB slow queries at 03:01–03:03 window.

oncall-ana: assigning follow-ups: mike_sre (a,b), kevin_prodeng (c), infra team (d), sara_poe (post-incident doc).

josh_sales: customers updated. No new high-sev reports. :thumbsup:

sara_poe: drafting postmortem, will include metrics: p95/p99 graphs, RPC error counts, cache-miss rate, affected customers list.

oncall-ana: handing off to kevin_prodeng for daytime monitoring. I'm off in 25m. Thanks all.

mike_sre: leaving a note: if this recurs, escalate to emergency DB scaling and consider putting config-service behind a lightweight read-cache proxy.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: incident cleared to "monitoring" state at 2026-03-14T03:14:49Z.

kevin_prodeng: acked handoff. Monitoring dashboards green for last 3m. Will update timeline in #postmortems later.

sara_poe: postmortem draft link: https://redwood.app/internal/postmortems/1792034567-ff-controlplane-latency (will attach graphs).

oncall-ana: closing thread, please add any late notes here. Good job everyone. :clap:
